pristine.sourcePolicy: byte-exact vendored packages/xstate-store-react/src/types.test.tsx compiled with the vendored src/index.ts against @xstate/store-react@2.0.0 type dependencies

adapted.sourcePolicy: the same suite compiled against the Octane binding source; the file is prettier-ignored so the one-line difference from upstream stays verifiable by diff

permittedTransformations.rule: upstream's sibling './index.ts' import retargets this package's ported source

headerPolicy: The adapted file may prepend a leading run of comments and the JSX pragma. Everything below it must equal the vendored upstream file once the transformations above are undone.

notApplicable.rule: The adapted suite stays .tsx rather than .tsrx. Lowering a .tsrx strips comments before TypeScript sees the program, so its thirteen @ts-expect-error markers would never apply and the negative assertions would silently invert.
